rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm the pink cat monster! Meow meow♪

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler B
rows.Line:
Haha! That's really cute!
I feel like we could be friends!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: Does this mean we'll run into more cute monsters and stuff if we keep going?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup☆
My friends are all waiting for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler C
rows.Line: Really?! Then, let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: Bye bye, pink cat monster!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye bye!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so glad I was able to send those kids on their way with smiles on their faces♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
I'm gonna make the next group smile just as much☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll hide behind this tree and... Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was scary...
I thought I was gonna get blown off the mountain!
Well, aren't you an adorable little monster.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
Hehe. Those children were a part of the final group.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Thank you for letting me know, ma'am!
You're welcome. And your acting was spectacular. I actually decided to come over after hearing that I'd find some cute monsters and spirits here.
I loved all your outfits.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My friends and I made our costumes together☆ We wanted to make sure people who don't like being scared would also have fun!

Hehe. I see.
I also heard some very lively voices in the afternoon. It's been quite a while since this place had so many visitors...
Also, it was nice to see the head priest with such a big smile on his face.
I've caused him quite a lot of trouble over the years, so I'm glad you were able to turn his frown upside down today. That made me very happy.
So, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, hehe...
I'm really glad we were able to help him!
se_walk_women_003_1
Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That voice... Hi, Asahina!
Did you come to get me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ma'am, let's go... Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:

Are you okay, ma—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu

A few days later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you all for helping with our volunteer event the other day☆ Cheers♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This mega fruit parfait looks so good!
Let's dig in♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Emu's going to town on it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You ordered some shaved ice, Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
It was very hot today, so I wanted to get something nice and cool...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That reminds me of the shaved ice we handed out while we were pulling weeds.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you gave out shaved ice?!
No fair! I totally would've wanted some!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Now I really regret not being there to pull weeds...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you were really active during the test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Not only did you do a wonderful job as a scarer, but those incredible costumes you made for us were very popular.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Especially Emu's costume.
Everyone seemed to really love the pink cat monster.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the old lady I met on the mountain also said she thought my costume was cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really? That's great.
Now I'm really glad I put so much effort into them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone also seemed to enjoy your acting performance, Otori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, you were so cute that I wouldn't be surprised if you ended up attracting some real ghosts.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Real ghosts?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Totally!
There's a cemetery right next to that shrine, so she might be right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Real ghosts...?!
I would've loved to hear what they thought about me as a monster.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure they would've told you how cute and fun you were.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Especially since the adorable costume that I'm so proud of was made even better by your acting, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've gotta think you would've made any ghost you came across smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That'd be so great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori, your yuki-onna costume was also really wonderhoy since you looked like the real thing☆ And I loved how you made it snow...
